extensions.scope: Only the /cuppy route (apps/web/src/app/(cuppy)/), which has its own root layout. Not the JuiceColored portfolio. Brand assets are owner-owned (Cuppy Ice Cream); publication permission pending. See docs/cuppy/README.md.

flavorRoles.note: One art-directed cream. The flavor selector was removed in the polish pass of 2026-11-23; the earlier per-flavor values are kept here for history and are not used.

display-word.purpose: The single full-bleed pedestal word at the hero's foot; size derived from its measured 8.27em advance so it never wraps.

display-lead.purpose: Opening phrase above the cup. Narrow screens: clamp(1.75rem, 9.6vw, 4rem).

headline.purpose: Reserved display step (the flavor band that used it was removed).

headline-close.purpose: Closing statement on ink; accent span in lavender.

title.purpose: Stepped ritual list (1.1em indent per line) with sparkles.

wordmark.purpose: Masthead name; 1.125rem below 960px. Suffix at 0.55em, 700, 0.12em tracking.

body-lead.purpose: Reserved lead step, max 30ch (the flavor line that used it was removed).

body.purpose: Default text; pitch at clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.1875rem); close copy 1.125rem, max 28ch.

label.purpose: Small uppercase labels. Concept tag uses 0.75rem at 112%, 0.08em.

fine-print.purpose: Footer disclosure, cream at 74% alpha, max 72ch.

shadows.name: cup-contact
shadows.value: Gaussian radial falloff, rgb(40 20 48), alpha exp(-1.6 (r/0.46)^2) (1 - r^2), reaching 0 at the edge
shadows.purpose: Two stacked ground planes under the 3D cup: soft 2.5 x 2.3 units at opacity 0.44, core 1.25 x 1.13 at 0.4; lifted 0.16 off the ground line and offset (0.1, -0.12) away from the key light; widening 4% and fading slightly as the cup bobs up; fading out over the ink close. Sized to the cup so it stays inside the phone lane.

motion.name: button
motion.purpose: Button lift, shadow and arrow nudge.

motion.name: sparkle-twinkle
motion.value: 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; scale 1 to 0.72, rotate 0 to 12deg; staggered -1.1s, -2.2s

motion.name: cup-float
motion.value: bob sin(1.15t) * 0.085; yaw sin(0.36t) * 0.42 + pointer.x * 0.45; pitch pointer.y * 0.16 + sin(0.8t) * 0.025; roll -pointer.x * 0.07 + sin(0.6t) * 0.03; pointer smoothing 1 - exp(-4dt)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (the OS/browser setting is the only switch; no in-page control, nothing stored)
motion.purpose: Read live in both directions. CSS (from the first paint, before script): sparkle animation and button transitions off, short reading layout, pull-narrating copy hidden; a <picture> source swaps in the still poster. Script: the scroll scene is torn down and one composed 3D still renders on demand in the hero slot (no frame loop); switching back restores the scroll scene. Never both at once. Without script (scripting: none) the same still layout applies.

motion.name: cream-drain
motion.value: drawn = 1 - (1 - p)^1.5, p = (scroll - cradle) / (maxScroll - cradle); sink 0.4d, tall 1 - 0.55d, wide 1 - 0.06 smoothstep(0, 0.05, d) - 0.09d
motion.purpose: The cream left in the cup settles into it as the strand lengthens: about half shows above the rim at mid-scroll, a thin layer at the end; reverses exactly. Cream geometry only: no cup, scene-scale or opacity change.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Hero stops filling the viewport; the pitch and CTA stack in the left column under the spoon room; grids collapse to copy plus the cup lane.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Wordmark suffix hidden, smaller concept tag.

focus.on-ink: cream button switches its outline color to #F2E6D2

camera.framing: product fills ~72% of stage height or 78% of width on narrow stages; ground line near the stage bottom

lights.name: key
lights.purpose: Warm window key from upper left.

materials.name: label-paper
materials.map: canvas label: ink #17131A on paper #F2E6D2; pixel sunglasses, CUPPY, ICE CREAM band with sparkles

materials.name: drip-cream
materials.note: clone of cream without vertex colors; three drips at angles 0.6, -2.1, 2.45 rad, lengths 0.46, 0.24, 0.32

object3d.fallback: WebP stills of the same model (apps/web/public/cuppy/poster-rest.webp for the scroll scene's first frame, poster-still.webp for the reduced-motion pose; 720x1068 CSS at 1.5x), chosen by a <picture> media source on prefers-reduced-motion and shown until live, without script, and on WebGL absence or context loss (up to 2 restarts). The older poster-<flavor>.webp renders are kept for history, unreferenced.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill CTA on lavender, with trailing up-right arrow.
components.html: Follow @cuppyicecream
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.4rem 0 1.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #17131A; color: #F2E6D2; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 118%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgb(23 19 26 / 0.7); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn svg { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 28px -16px rgb(23 19 26 / 0.8); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17131A; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Cream Button
components.description: Cream pill CTA for the ink close section.
components.html: Follow @cuppyicecream
components.css: .ds-btn-cream { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.4rem 0 1.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #F2E6D2; color: #17131A; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 118%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-cream svg { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-cream:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-cream:hover svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-btn-cream:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F2E6D2; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Concept Tag
components.description: Outlined pill disclosing that the page is an internal concept.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; margin: 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; border: 2px solid #17131A; border-radius: 999px; color: #17131A; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Wordmark left; concept tag right. No navigation links and no in-page controls.
components.css: .ds-mast { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; height: 4.5rem; padding: 0 clamp(1rem, 3.2vw, 2.75rem); background: #C397C4; color: #17131A; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { margin: 0; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 125%; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mark span { margin-left: 0.35em; font-size: 0.55em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; vertical-align: 0.3em; } .ds-mast-tag { margin: 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; border: 2px solid #17131A; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Sparkle
components.description: Ink four-point sparkle, the world's only ornament; twinkles on the hero, static elsewhere.
components.css: .ds-sparkles { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 24px; background: #C397C4; } .ds-sparkle { width: 2.5rem; fill: #17131A; animation: ds-twinkle 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-sparkle-b { width: 1.5rem; animation-delay: -1.1s; } @keyframes ds-twinkle { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: scale(0.72) rotate(12deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sparkle { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A drenched lavender ground carries ink type so wide and heavy that it reads as a printed cup band. The product does not sit beside the copy; a real 3D soft-serve cup floats inside the sentence, between the lead line and a full-bleed pedestal word, and its soft plum contact shadow lands on the letters below it. Everything else (the pitch and its CTA) is small, quiet, and pinned to the edge so the cup and the word own the first viewport. One art-directed product, the vanilla swirl; no flavor choice.

Density is low and the voice is loud only at display size. Color is the brand's own: lavender as the field, ink for type, outlines and buttons, cream only where it can be read (on ink or chocolate). Chocolate and caramel stay in the measured palette but are unused since the flavor selector was removed. Ink four-point sparkles are the world's ornament and appear on the page, the ritual list and the printed cup label.

Motion is soft and physical, and the signature moment is the pull, driven by the page's own scroll: a spoon lifts the real top of the swirl and stays where it was in the document while the cup travels down with the reader, so a continuous ribbon of cream stretches the length of the page, drawing down the cream left in the cup, and reassembles on the way back. Around it: a slow bob and pointer tilt at rest, a cubic ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) on every UI transition. The visitor's prefers-reduced-motion setting is the only motion switch; reduced motion gets one composed 3D still and a short reading layout instead of the scroll scene.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender field, ink type, cream only on dark fields.
Archivo at 125% width, weight 900, uppercase, tight negative tracking for display.
The 3D cup sits in the headline, not beside it.
Ink four-point sparkles as the only ornament.
The cream in the cup drains into the strand as the page scrolls.

rules.name: The Cream Stays Off Lavender Rule
rules.body: Cream text on lavender measures about 2:1 and is never used. Cream type appears only on ink or chocolate; on lavender, cream, and caramel the text is ink.

rules.name: The Flavor Is a Field Rule
rules.body: If flavor colors return, they arrive as full-width fields, each paired with its contrast ink (vanilla: ink, chocolate: cream, caramel: ink), never sprinkled as accents on the lavender hero.

rules.name: The Width Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by the width axis and weight, not by switching families: 125% for display, 112–118% for labels and buttons, 100% for reading text. Uppercase is reserved for widened text; body copy is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display sizes always take negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.03em) and line-height under 0.92; tracked-out uppercase is for small labels only.

rules.name: The Soft Tint Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred, offset downward, and tinted ink or plum. The cream button on ink takes no shadow.

dos: Do set every display line in Archivo at 125% width, weight 900, uppercase, with negative tracking.
Do keep the product inside the headline composition, with its contact shadow landing on the type.
Do use the ink four-point sparkle as the ornament, in ink or `currentColor`.
Do run every UI transition on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and drop it under `prefers-reduced-motion`; give the 3D object a composed still pose, not a frozen frame.
Do keep a still render of the same model behind the live canvas so the object never disappears.
Do keep the "Internal concept" tag and the footer disclosure on any page in this world until publication permission is granted.
donts: Don't set cream text on lavender (about 2:1).
Don't split the hero into copy left and product right with a badge row; the cup lives in the sentence.
Don't use grey or neutral black shadows; tint them ink or plum.
Don't apply these tokens to the JuiceColored portfolio routes.
Don't use Cuppy's logo or mascot artwork, or the site's display face, in the build; they are reference only.
